svg.aria-label: A running session is deleted only if it is not protected, has no client attached, every pane is at a shell prompt and it has been idle long enough. Each check it fails keeps it, with the words the dashboard shows: protected: claude, attached, running npm run dev, reap in 11h 10m. An exited session is deleted once it has been gone long enough, unless protected. A fact it cannot read keeps the session too.
